description: Official time series, release vintages, revisions, and company filings, plus the public-finance feature's budget plans, outturns, beneficiary payments and government finance statistics (figures as published, each with its accounting basis), and the demographics feature's population, migration, asylum and displacement series (values as published, each with its definition, geography level and vintage), and the Funding & Grants development-finance feature's OECD Creditor Reporting System aggregates (vintaged statistics with the OECD as publisher, never decomposed into activities)., and the trade features' reported goods flows by reporter, partner and product (UN Comtrade and Eurostat Comext, reporter and mirror reports kept apart, each with classification and release vintage) and WITS classification concordances, and the labour-statistics feature's published labour-force indicators (ILOSTAT, OECD, Eurostat LFS and BLS series as released, each with definition basis, seasonal adjustment and release vintage; never nowcast, blended or re-harmonised), and the business-statistics feature's industry and business statistics (Eurostat short-term business statistics and business demography and US Census County Business Patterns as released, each with statistical unit, classification, adjustment, flags and release vintage; never nowcast, blended, re-based or reconstructed), and the tourism-statistics feature's Eurostat tourism occupancy and capacity series (nights spent, arrivals, establishments and bed places as released, each with residence, accommodation type, NUTS version, flags and release vintage; monthly and annual series kept apart; never nowcast, filled, blended or derived).
